facts.fact: The Senate passed a bill repealing and re-enacting the 2007 NIMC Act to set up a National Identity Database and strengthen the legal framework for national and digital identity, per the Senate committee chairman.
facts.system: NIMC Act repeal and re-enactment bill

NGA.note: No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the system.

Bill is for a database; no system status, biometric check or certification stated.

facts.fact: The Senate committee chairman said the national identity bill received overwhelming support from stakeholders at the public hearing.
